l1_words.meaning: to intend, to plan to do something

pattern_explanation: Each Portuguese word looks close to an English word, so learners tend to match by appearance. In this card the look-alike English word has a different meaning, so the correct pair is the English word that carries the same meaning as the Portuguese word.
false_friend_warning: Portuguese learners often match the verb meaning 'to intend' with 'pretend' because the two look alike, but 'pretend' means to act as if something is true when it is not, so the correct match is 'intend'.
